resolution: User clarified that running InstantMesh WITHOUT --export_texmap yields a single .obj (what they did yesterday). Verified in deps/InstantMesh/src/utils/mesh_util.py: save_obj (no-texmap path) builds a trimesh with vertex_colors and exports OBJ, so it writes a single .obj with per-vertex RGB on extended 'v x y z r g b' lines (no .mtl, no .png). Confirmed the importer drops color in BOTH modes: vertex-color mode -- importPropMesh.mjs parseObj does parts.slice(0,3) on v lines, discarding trailing r g b; texmap mode -- no .mtl/.png handling, falls back to flat --color (#9b8066). Also noted prop vertex format is stride-8 (pos3+normal3+uv2) with NO color channel, so carrying vertex colors needs a format extension to stride-11 (RGB) or baking colors into a texture. No code changed (check/report). Presented two fix options: A) support single-obj vertex-color path (read rgb, extend vertex format, shader reads it) -- recommended, matches user usage; B) support texmap path (parse mtl map_Kd, decode png via @reactjit/image, bake as textureKey/material on parsed UVs). Awaiting user choice.
